entry.title: New: DSH-taskboard
entry.summary: Local SQLite taskboard as a native overlay page: projects, tasks, comments, relations, attachments and workflow automation, with backlog → todo → in_progress → in_review → done statuses, `taskboard_*` Agent tools that can only submit work to in_review, a headless JSON CLI and a packaged skill. Exact install spec: github:shengsheng90/dsh-taskboard. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
